description: This Java class 'DefaultJwtAuthenticationResultProvider' implements the 'JwtAuthenticationResultProvider' interface. It provides functionality to generate an 'AuthenticationResult' based on a JSON Web Token (JWT) and headers, utilizing an 'JwtAuthorizationSubjectsProvider' to extract authorization subjects from the JWT. The class offers a static factory method to instantiate itself with a provided authorization subjects provider.

classes.name: DefaultJwtAuthenticationResultProvider
classes.description: Implements authentication result creation based on JWT tokens and authorization subjects.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DefaultJwtAuthenticationResultProvider with a specified JwtAuthorizationSubjectsProvider.

methods.name: getAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Generates an AuthenticationResult object based on a given JsonWebToken and headers.
